schemas.name: Box
schemas.doc: An axis-aligned box centred on the origin.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Full extents along X, Y and Z.

fields.name: friction
fields.doc: Coulomb friction coefficient.

fields.name: restitution
fields.doc: Bounciness, 0 (none) to 1 (perfect).

fields.name: sensor
fields.doc: A sensor reports collisions but does not push other bodies.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Full extents along X, Y and Z.

schemas.name: Camera
schemas.doc: The fields of a `camera` scene object. Looks along its local -Z axis, or at `target` when one is declared.

fields.name: active
fields.doc: Marks the active camera. Optional when the scene has exactly one camera; with several cameras exactly one must declare `active: true`.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Camera position in world space, in metres.

fields.name: projection
fields.doc: `Perspective {..}` or `Orthographic {..}`. The projection kind is construction-only; the fields of the descriptor are writable and bindable.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Orientation when no `target` is declared.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: Optional point to look at (up is +Y). When declared, `rotation` must not be.

schemas.name: DirectionalLight
schemas.doc: A light infinitely far away. Travels along the entity's world -Z axis; rotate the entity to aim it.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Light colour (linear RGB; alpha is ignored).

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Illuminance in lux.

schemas.name: Dynamic
schemas.doc: A solver-controlled body; forces, impulses and teleports are explicit commands.

fields.name: angular_damping
fields.doc: Rate at which angular velocity decays.

fields.name: linear_damping
fields.doc: Rate at which linear velocity decays.

fields.name: mass
fields.doc: Mass in kilograms.

schemas.name: Entity
schemas.doc: The fields of an entity or prefab body: a named node with a transform and optional components.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: A physics body (`Static`, `Dynamic`, `Kinematic`). Root entities only.

fields.name: collider
fields.doc: A collision shape (`BoxCollider`, `SphereCollider`). Requires `body`.

fields.name: light
fields.doc: A light component (`DirectionalLight`, `PointLight`). Its fields are writable and bindable as their schemas say. Named entities only.

fields.name: material
fields.doc: The material instance used to draw the mesh. The instance is construction-only; its parameters are writable and bindable. Requires `mesh`.

fields.name: mesh
fields.doc: The mesh drawn for this entity: a mesh descriptor (`Box`, `Sphere`, `Plane`) or an asset mesh.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Position local to the parent, in metres.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Rotation local to the parent.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Scale local to the parent. Construction-only (and `vec3(1.0)` for dynamic and kinematic bodies) when the entity has a body; that rule belongs to the checker, not to this field.

fields.name: visible
fields.doc: Hides the mesh draw only; the entity's behaviour keeps running.

schemas.name: Kinematic
schemas.doc: A body whose pose the program sets with `set_kinematic_target`.

schemas.name: Orthographic
schemas.doc: An orthographic projection (right-handed, clip depth 0 to 1).

fields.name: far
fields.doc: Distance to the far plane.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height of the view volume in world units; the width follows from the aspect ratio.

fields.name: near
fields.doc: Distance to the near plane.

schemas.name: Pbr
schemas.doc: The documented PBR subset (metallic-roughness, no image-based lighting). Defined in the embedded prelude source `std/materials.mtek`.

fields.name: base_color
fields.doc: Linear base colour multiplied with the base colour texture.

fields.name: base_color_sampler
fields.doc: Sampler for the base colour texture.

fields.name: base_color_texture
fields.doc: Base colour texture.

fields.name: metallic
fields.doc: Metalness; clamped to 0..1 by the lighting model.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Perceptual roughness; clamped to 0.045..1 by the lighting model.

schemas.name: Perspective
schemas.doc: A perspective projection (right-handed, clip depth 0 to 1).

fields.name: far
fields.doc: Distance to the far plane.

fields.name: fov_y
fields.doc: Full vertical field of view in radians.

fields.name: near
fields.doc: Distance to the near plane.

schemas.name: Plane
schemas.doc: A single-sided horizontal plane at y = 0 facing +Y.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Extent along X and Z.

schemas.name: PointLight
schemas.doc: A light radiating from the entity's world position.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Light colour (linear RGB; alpha is ignored).

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Luminous intensity in candela.

fields.name: range
fields.doc: Distance at which the light fades to nothing; 0 means unlimited.

schemas.name: Scene
schemas.doc: The fields of a scene declaration. All are construction-only and must be constant expressions.

fields.name: ambient_color
fields.doc: Colour of the ambient light term of lit materials. Only the RGB channels are used.

fields.name: ambient_intensity
fields.doc: Scale of the ambient light term of lit materials; 0 turns ambient light off.

fields.name: clear_color
fields.doc: Colour the canvas is cleared to. Only the RGB channels are used.

fields.name: gravity
fields.doc: Gravitational acceleration in metres per second squared. Used only when the scene has physics bodies.

schemas.name: Sphere
schemas.doc: A UV sphere centred on the origin.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius in metres.

fields.name: rings
fields.doc: Subdivisions from pole to pole.

fields.name: segments
fields.doc: Subdivisions around the Y axis.

fields.name: friction
fields.doc: Coulomb friction coefficient.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius in metres.

fields.name: restitution
fields.doc: Bounciness, 0 (none) to 1 (perfect).

fields.name: sensor
fields.doc: A sensor reports collisions but does not push other bodies.

schemas.name: Static
schemas.doc: An immovable body; its pose is fixed at creation from the entity transform.

schemas.name: Unlit
schemas.doc: Flat colour, no lighting. Defined in the embedded prelude source `std/materials.mtek`.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: The colour written to the canvas.

events.name: collision_enter
events.doc: The entity's collider started touching another entity's collider; the parameter is the other entity.

events.name: collision_exit
events.doc: The entity's collider stopped touching another entity's collider; the parameter is the other entity.

events.name: key_down
events.doc: Delivered when the filtered key transitions to pressed. Auto-repeat is ignored.

events.name: key_up
events.doc: Delivered when the filtered key is released.

events.name: pointer_down
events.doc: A pointer button was pressed on the canvas.

events.name: pointer_move
events.doc: The pointer moved; at most once per frame with the latest position.

enums.name: Key
enums.doc: A physical keyboard key, independent of the keyboard layout. Maps from the DOM `KeyboardEvent.code`; events with any other code are ignored by the runtime.

intrinsics.name: alive
intrinsics.doc: Whether the entity reference points at a live entity.

intrinsics.name: atan2
intrinsics.doc: Angle of the point `(x, y)` in radians; note the argument order `atan2(y, x)`.

intrinsics.name: clamp
signatures: (x: T, lo: T, hi: T) -> T
(x: I, lo: I, hi: I) -> I

intrinsics.name: cos
intrinsics.doc: Cosine of an angle in radians.

intrinsics.name: destroy
intrinsics.doc: Queues removal of a spawned entity; it counts as dead from the moment of the call.

intrinsics.name: is_key_down
intrinsics.doc: Whether the key was down at the end of input handling in the current frame.

intrinsics.name: length
intrinsics.doc: Length of a vector, or the absolute value of a scalar.

intrinsics.name: mix
signatures: (a: T, b: T, t: T) -> T
intrinsics.doc: Linear interpolation `a * (1 - t) + b * t`, with a scalar or a component-wise `t`.

intrinsics.name: normalize
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: A zero vector gives the zero vector on the CPU; non-portable on the GPU.

intrinsics.name: print
intrinsics.doc: Writes a message to the development console.

intrinsics.name: random
intrinsics.cpuSemantics: Seeded PRNG (xoshiro128**, seed from the mount options); deterministic under a fixed seed.

intrinsics.name: reflect
intrinsics.doc: Reflects incident vector `i` about the surface normal `n`.

intrinsics.name: round
intrinsics.doc: Nearest integer value, halves to even.

intrinsics.name: sample
signatures: (t: texture, s: sampler, uv: vec2) -> vec4
intrinsics.doc: Filtered texel of `t` at `uv`. `texture` and `sampler` parameters may be used only as direct arguments to `sample`.

intrinsics.name: sign
intrinsics.doc: -1, 0 or 1 according to the sign of `x`.

intrinsics.name: sin
intrinsics.doc: Sine of an angle in radians.

intrinsics.name: smoothstep
signatures: (edge0: T, edge1: T, x: T) -> T

intrinsics.name: spawn
intrinsics.doc: Queues creation of a prefab instance as a root entity; the reference is valid immediately and `alive` turns true after the next lifecycle flush.

intrinsics.name: step
intrinsics.doc: 0 where `x < edge`, otherwise 1, component-wise. WGSL argument order: `step(edge, x)`.

intrinsics.name: tan
intrinsics.doc: Tangent of an angle in radians.

intrinsics.name: trunc
intrinsics.doc: Integer part of `x`, rounding toward zero.

namespaces.name: asset
namespaces.doc: Compile-time asset declarations. The argument must be a string literal naming a file inside the project.

members.name: glb
members.doc: A static GLB model. May be stored only in a `const` and used through its accessors.

members.name: linear_texture
members.doc: A linear data texture (masks, normal data).

members.name: srgb
members.cpuSemantics: `f32` arithmetic per operation; not folded in constant expressions, because folding in `f64` would give different bits (use a `#rrggbb` literal for constants).
members.doc: A colour from sRGB-encoded components, converted to linear light with the exact sRGB transfer function at run time.

namespaces.name: frame
namespaces.doc: Per-frame values. Readable in CPU code and in `bind` expressions, not in GPU stage code: route them through material parameters.

members.name: delta
members.doc: The clamped frame delta of the current rendered frame; the value passed to `update`.

members.name: index
members.doc: Rendered frame counter since mount, wrapping.

members.name: time
members.doc: Active application time in seconds since mount, excluding paused time.

namespaces.name: lighting
namespaces.doc: Lighting functions for material fragment stages.

members.name: pbr
signatures: (surface: SurfaceInput, base_color: color, metallic: f32, roughness: f32) -> color
members.doc: The documented PBR subset evaluated for every light in the scene.

members.name: columns
signatures: (c0: vec4, c1: vec4, c2: vec4, c3: vec4) -> mat4

members.name: axis_angle
members.doc: Rotation by `angle` radians about `axis`. The axis is normalised; a zero axis gives the identity on the CPU.

members.name: euler
signatures: (x: f32, y: f32, z: f32) -> quat
members.doc: Rotation about Z, then X, then Y, all about fixed world axes: `axis_angle(+Y, y) * axis_angle(+X, x) * axis_angle(+Z, z)`.

members.name: linear_clamp
members.doc: Bilinear filtering, texture coordinates clamp to the edge.

members.name: nearest_clamp
members.doc: Nearest-texel filtering, texture coordinates clamp to the edge.

types.name: PointerEvent
types.doc: A pointer event: `position` in normalised canvas coordinates (x right, y up, both in -1..1) and the `button` (0 primary, 1 middle, 2 secondary).

types.name: SurfaceInput
types.doc: The interpolated inputs of a material fragment stage; the compiler records which fields a material reads.

types.name: array
types.doc: The generic `array<T, N>`: a fixed-length array of `N` (1 to 65536) elements of type `T`.

types.name: bool
types.doc: Truth value.

types.name: color
types.doc: Linear-light RGBA with straight alpha; distinct from `vec4`.

types.name: entity_ref
types.doc: A generation-checked reference to an entity. Supports comparison, `alive`, `destroy` and body commands only.

types.name: f32
types.doc: IEEE-754 binary32 floating-point number.

types.name: glb_asset
types.doc: The compile-time handle of `asset.glb(..)`; may be stored only in a `const` and used through its accessors.

methods.name: material
methods.doc: The glTF material with this name as a `Pbr` instance with every parameter taken from the file.

methods.name: material_base_color
methods.doc: The linear `baseColorFactor` of the material; alpha must be 1.

methods.name: material_texture
methods.doc: The `baseColorTexture` of the material, or `texture.white()` when absent.

methods.name: mesh
methods.doc: The glTF mesh with this name; it must have exactly one primitive.

methods.name: node_position
methods.doc: World position of the node in the default scene.

methods.name: node_rotation
methods.doc: World rotation of the node in the default scene.

methods.name: node_scale
methods.doc: World scale of the node in the default scene.

methods.name: primitive
methods.doc: Primitive `index` (an integer literal) of the named glTF mesh.

types.name: i32
types.doc: 32-bit signed integer.

types.name: mat4
types.doc: 4x4 `f32` matrix, column-major; multiplies column vectors on the right.

types.name: material
types.doc: A material instance with its own parameter storage.

types.name: mesh
types.doc: An immutable mesh: a primitive descriptor or an asset mesh.

types.name: quat
types.doc: Unit quaternion `(x, y, z, w)`; distinct from `vec4`.

types.name: sampler
types.doc: A sampler preset. Usable only as a material parameter.

types.name: string
types.doc: Immutable text. CPU only.

types.name: texture
types.doc: An immutable texture. Usable only as a material parameter.

types.name: u32
types.doc: 32-bit unsigned integer.

types.name: vec2
types.doc: Two `f32` components.

types.name: vec3
types.doc: Three `f32` components.

types.name: vec4
types.doc: Four `f32` components.

sceneObjects.doc: Declares a camera: `camera Main { .. }`. A scene needs exactly one active camera.

bodyCommands.name: apply_force
bodyCommands.doc: A force in newtons applied for exactly the next tick, then cleared.

bodyCommands.name: apply_impulse
bodyCommands.doc: Instantaneous change of momentum in newton-seconds, at the centre of mass, applied at the start of the next tick.

bodyCommands.name: set_kinematic_target
bodyCommands.doc: The pose reached at the end of the next tick; the solver derives the velocity.

bodyCommands.name: set_linear_velocity
bodyCommands.doc: Sets the linear velocity at the start of the next tick.

bodyCommands.name: teleport
bodyCommands.doc: Sets the pose before the next tick; velocities are zeroed unless `keep_velocity` is true.

bodyProperties.name: angular_velocity
bodyProperties.doc: Angular velocity as of the last completed tick. Read-only.

bodyProperties.name: linear_velocity
bodyProperties.doc: Linear velocity as of the last completed tick. Read-only.
